provider_note: Claude Code cannot switch the main session's model per prompt. Routing = the main session hands the task to a subagent (.claude/agents/ue-l*.md) whose frontmatter pins the model. External endpoints (OpenRouter etc.) need a proxy on ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (e.g. claude-code-router) and switch the whole session, not a single task.
estimate_assumptions_note: Savings are ESTIMATES in relative units: tokens a task of the level typically costs x (flagship cost weight - routed model cost weight). Edit the weights to your real per-token prices; they are not official prices.

gemini_antigravity.note: Designer 2026-11-25: Antigravity (Gemini 4) models, weakest -> strongest: Hydrogen < Argon (leaving, never use) < Carbon < Neon < Orchestrator (= Neon High, Lead OK only). HYDROGEN is the workhorse for every task. CARBON / NEON: only for SHORT checks and code FIXES (a review pass, a failing test / build error fix, one bounded bug) - never for whole features, sweeps, long runs or mass use; switch back to Hydrogen right after. Designer 2026-11-25 evening: code written by Hydrogen is reviewed by NEON (not Carbon) before every FINISH. Expensive: they eat the subscription.

by_level.3: Hydrogen (NEON reviews Hydrogen's diff before FINISH; Neon also for a short fix inside the task)
by_level.4: Hydrogen + Lead plan (NEON reviews Hydrogen's diff before FINISH; Neon also for a short fix inside the task)
